description: Change how the in-app bug widget looks for one project; installed SDKs pick it up at their next start, with no redeploy. Send any of accent (a hex colour like #3b5bdb, or "auto" to match the site; Mushi picks black or white text with at least 3:1 contrast), position (top-left | top-right | bottom-left | bottom-right), theme (auto | light | dark | inherit), triggerText (up to 24 characters; "" restores the default icon) and launcher (auto | banner | edge-tab | attach | manual | hidden). A value the app's own code sets wins over the console, so if nothing changes in the app, check Mushi.init. Project owners and admins only (403 otherwise); 60 changes an hour per app. Optional projectId. Returns { before, after, changed }. Write.

accent.description: Hex colour like #3b5bdb, or "auto" to match the site

projectId.description: Project UUID — defaults to the server-configured project when omitted (`project_id` is accepted too.)

theme.description: auto follows the OS; inherit follows the page

triggerText.description: Launcher label, up to 24 characters; "" restores the default icon

name: set_widget_settings
title: Change the bug widget look
